blogs.title: Beyond LoRA: Why Orthogonal Finetuning is the Next Big Leap in AI Adaptation
blogs.description: This post introduces the core concept of Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT) to a general tech audience. It explains why preserving the 'angles' between neurons matters more than just adding low-rank updates (like LoRA) for maintaining a model's original knowledge. We'll break down how OFT offers better stability and generalization, setting the stage for why we need to make it more efficient.

blogs.title: From FFT to Fine-Tuning: How Butterfly Structures Solve the Parameter Problem
blogs.description: Dive into the clever mathematical trick behind the new BOFT method. This article demystifies how researchers borrowed the 'butterfly structure' from the famous Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithm to create dense orthogonal matrices using far fewer parameters. We'll use analogies of efficient data routing to explain how multiplying several sparse matrices can achieve what one giant matrix does, drastically cutting down memory usage without sacrificing performance.

blogs.title: The Graph Theory of AI: Visualizing Model Training as Information Transmission
blogs.description: Explore the unique 'Information Transmission' framework proposed in the paper. Instead of viewing matrix multiplication as pure algebra, this post explains how the authors reimagined finetuning as moving data across a grid-like graph. Readers will learn how this perspective helped identify the flaws in previous block-diagonal methods and led to the discovery of optimal network topologies for updating massive foundation models.

blogs.title: One Method to Rule Them All: Testing BOFT on Vision, Language, and Art
blogs.description: Focus on the empirical results and real-world applications of Orthogonal Butterfly (BOFT). This post highlights how this new technique isn't limited to just text or images but serves as a universal adapter for Large Language Models, Vision Transformers, and Text-to-Image diffusion models like Stable Diffusion. We'll discuss the benchmark results showing how BOFT outperforms current state-of-the-art methods while introducing zero latency during inference.
